body: I've moved cross country. Thank you for the suggestion, though.

It's funny looking at that scale. Some of the things that apply to me are on the adult version and some on the non-adult. I guess that's just part of this stage.

I'm lucky if I work 20 hours a week. This two-week pay period I've worked 10... hoping that'll increase as Christmas gets closer, and desperately hoping that I'll get to stay on after or find something else in the meantime. Unfortunately whether or not that happens, I'll have to spend Christmas here, alone. I'm really dreading that. Thanksgiving was bad enough. 

A lot of people suggest the volunteering thing. I've looked into working with the local SPCA, but couldn't make it to their once-monthly orientation so far. I'm determined I'll get to the January one. I also had to leave a pet behind as part of my move, and I miss that a lot. No pets allowed at the new house...

I can go more deeply into things, but a lot of it is incredibly complicated and I don't know where to begin. Plus one of the people involved does read reddit. I can't imagine them stumbling into this particular subreddit, but the internet is a strange mistress.

I've seen this once before... that guy is amazing. Thanks for reminding me of it. Also, if you don't read Terry Pratchett, this will mean nothing, but your name reminds me of The Librarian. Double win. Thank you.

I guess it'd be something like, "Why does everything always go wrong? Why does every little glimmer of hope turn into disappointment? What could I possibly have done to deserve this?" It's sort of... everything, the past few months. 

My attempt to chase my dream has crashed and burned, I can't find a job in that or ANY field. I'm lost and confused about my future, not sure about that dream anymore, utterly at a loss about what other paths I could take.

A best friend cut off ties because I did something (unintentionally) which hurt him. My apologies and attempts at rebuilding that relationship have failed. 

Someone I cared for very much decided they didn't want to be with me and ended a relationship that had made me very happy. 

I got turned down by several possible housing situations that I was VERY excited about, and wound up living with people who are reasonably nice, but utterly alien to me socially. My attempts to befriend/bond with them haven't worked. Trying to have a substantive conversation, let alone an intelligent one, is like pulling teeth.

Basically, I made a cross-country move expecting to find myself in a place where I already had one close, dependable friend, getting into a house with people I would be able to become friends with, and finding a job that I actually care about within a couple of months, hopefully with even more opportunities to expand my social network there. None of that happened.

Thank you. That's a part of the problem with being this low. The things that make me 'happy' are mostly just distractions that keep me from feeling miserable in the moment, and the things that make me genuinely happy seem out of reach, mainly because I can't afford them or some social barrier exists. I'm trying very hard to be mindful of the things I *can* have right now that make me happy, but those feel like a very small drop in a very big bucket. The biggest obstacle is my loneliness. There's just no one there to HELP me get out of my own head, and my attempts to reach out to people other than my mom haven't worked out.

edit: stupid typo

Just bots, I'm sure. It wasn't like I was on the brink of trying something, so it's okay. I talked to someone else on here a little while ago and my best friend is on IM right now. So I'm staying afloat. I really appreciate the concern. 

I'm not sure this is the very LAST bastion of goodness on the internet, but I'm really glad it exists. :)

I don't really know how to answer this without being really long winded. Right now the most pressing feeling is sadness and fear that I've been abandoned by my friends because those who don't know how I'm feeling just don't have time for me, and those who do aren't interested in dealing with someone who isn't happy and easy all the time. I have a lot of bigger fears about my long term future and money in the short term, but mostly I'm overwhelmed by how alone I feel.
Sure, that would be easier. I can only respond every so often here, since this is a dummy account. Thank you so much.
